decorative, VoiceOver reads only "A pitch showing a five-step move". The real board (BoardRenderer, Timeline.state(at:) in a TimelineView) cycles steps 1 to 5: each step holds 1.0 s, then moves at the step's own duration (1.2 s / 1.4 s); the chip under the board moves with it (step change 220 ms, the one curve); after step 5 it holds 1.5 s and starts again. Hidden at accessibility text sizes (AX1 to AX5)
interactions.reduced_motion: no movement: shows each step still for 2 s, then a 300 ms crossfade to the next

interactions.effect: decorative, VoiceOver reads only "The move playing in the tilted Broadcast camera". The real board through the broadcast camera (BoardRenderer Options.broadcast, CameraTrack.target(at: t)) plays the whole overlap (steps 1 to 5, Timeline-driven) with a progress bar under it, holds 1.5 s on the last step and loops. Hidden at accessibility text sizes (D-78)
interactions.reduced_motion: no movement and no panning: the still Broadcast view fitted to the whole move (CameraTrack.span), each step still for 2 s with 300 ms crossfades; the bar jumps per step

interactions.effect: decorative, VoiceOver reads only "A vertical video of the move in the Broadcast camera, with its title at the top". The 9:16 export frame drawn by ExportFrame with camera .broadcast (title band, step notes in Kalam, "CenterSpot" mark), playing and looping after a 1.5 s hold. Hidden at accessibility text sizes (D-78)
interactions.reduced_motion: no movement: step-through with 300 ms crossfades; notes change with the step

interactions.trigger: appears when the example move opens (Start, or the first board opened after Skip)
interactions.effect: TipKit popover, one TipGroup(.ordered) for all five. A closed or completed tip is invalidated and never shows again (TipKit datastore, survives relaunch); tips never show while playing, drawing or with a sheet open. Anchor: board.token.h3, below it, arrow up; anchored to the token's 44 pt accessibility hit view, not the Canvas. Completed (invalidate .actionPerformed) when any player is dragged (moving a token in any step); the next tip becomes eligible. The tip never covers its control.
close this tip (invalidate .tipClosed): it never shows again; the next tip in the group becomes eligible as if tip.drag were done. VoiceOver: "Close tip"

interactions.trigger: appears when tip.drag is done or closed

interactions.effect: camera: Flat (top-down, the editing framing, same numbered discs). From Broadcast the camera tilts back up over --d-camera while the Timeline keeps playing; the choice is remembered per tactic (app.camera) and is the export default
interactions.reduced_motion: no tilt animation: crossfade 300 ms between the two cameras

interactions.effect: camera: Broadcast (tilted, looking up the pitch, following the ball's path as a pure function of t, D-06, D-66). Tilts down over --d-camera; discs, zones, lines, arrows and glow rings lie flat on the grass (discs become ellipses); numbers stay upright so they read at any distance
interactions.reduced_motion: no tilt or pan animation: crossfade 300 ms; under Reduce Motion the broadcast camera holds a fixed framing per step and cuts between steps, never swoops

interactions.effect: picks Zone: a drag on the grass draws a see-through box on the current step; a drag that starts on a player draws a box too (players don't move in Zone)
picks Line: tap players in order to join them (2 or more, one side); tapping the last player again, picking another tool or Done finishes the line; a tap on the grass does nothing
picks Glow: tap a player to put rings under them (they follow the player), or tap the grass to drop a heat glow there; tapping an existing glow selects it
a box from the touch-down point to the finger, dashed while dragging, filled on lift; under 4% of the pitch on either side is ignored (a tap); the new zone is selected with four corner handles
interactions.reduced_motion: no fade-in; the zone appears on lift

interactions.effect: tap selects the zone (handles + the 'Zone 1 · step 4' row with Remove); drag inside a selected zone moves it, clamped to the pitch (0…1)
resizes the zone from its top-left corner; the opposite corner stays put; minimum 4% each side; clamped to 0…1
resizes the zone from its top-right corner; the opposite corner stays put; minimum 4% each side; clamped to 0…1
resizes the zone from its bottom-left corner; the opposite corner stays put; minimum 4% each side; clamped to 0…1
resizes the zone from its bottom-right corner; the opposite corner stays put; minimum 4% each side; clamped to 0…1
removes the selected mark (zone, line or glow) from this step; undoable; Cancel takes back the whole draw session (D-62)

each tap adds the player to the line and draws the segment to them; the last-tapped player shows a dashed pending ring; a player already in the line is ignored except the last (finishes); a player of the other side starts nothing and shows the hint 'One side per line'
on a player: rings fade in under them (they follow the player through the step); on the grass: a heat glow fades in at that point; a second tap on the same glow selects it (Remove in the row)
interactions.reduced_motion: no ring expansion: appears at full size with a 220 ms opacity fade

interactions.effect: marks belong to a step like arrows (D-46): they fade in over the first 15% of their step and out over the last 15% of the step they end on (or hold for 'holdSteps'); shape lines and rings follow their players' interpolated positions every frame; zones and heat stay put. Pure function of t (D-06); same in the export (D-07)
interactions.reduced_motion: in-app playback under Reduce Motion steps through with 300 ms crossfades; exported video never changes (rule 8)

interactions.effect: video camera: Flat (top-down, pitch upright; in 16:9 the pitch sits in the middle, title left, note right, D-63); the preview re-renders; the size line updates ("Up to ...", D-64)
video camera: Broadcast (tilted, follows the ball, fills more of the frame; discs flat on the grass with upright numbers); the preview re-renders; the size line updates ("Up to ...", D-64)
interactions.reduced_motion: preview cuts; the exported video is the same with Reduce Motion on (rule 8)
